title: 【日本史】01 忙しい人のための旧石器時代から江戸時代まで / Japan History Rapid Overview
description: A high-density survey of Japanese history from the Paleolithic period through the Edo era, designed for busy JLPT N2 prep students. Uses on-screen timeline and kanji labels for each historical period (旧石器, 縄文, 弥生, 古墳, 飛鳥, 奈良, 平安, 鎌倉, 室町, 戦国, 江戸). Covers major transitions, key figures, and cultural developments with a rapid narration pace. Excellent for building vocabulary around historical period names and understanding the broad chronology of Japanese civilization.
creator: 見て覚える日本史シリーズ (Japanese History Learn-by-Watching series)
